summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K announcing a Board Meeting on 5 May 2026 to approve the Q1 2026 earnings release and consider a first interim dividend for 2026. The dividend, if approved, will be payable 26 June 2026 to holders of record on 15 May 2026. No special situation transaction (e.g., acquisition, divestiture, restructuring) is disclosed. This is a routine periodic earnings and dividend declaration announcement, which does not constitute a special-situation event.
